An autouse fixture that sets the key for those tests (mirroring tests/ids/test_candidate_judgment.py) would remove the environment dependence. The new test is unaffected: it deliberately removes the key and asserts the skip.

justifications.durability: The new guard is falsifiable: this review's own mutation (deleting the up-front gate from the head tree at workers.py) reddens the new test (1 failed EXIT=1), and the opposite direction is also held because the existing tests/cli/test_discover_map.py candidate-worker tests fail if judgments_available() wrongly reports the key absent, so an over-eager gate would be caught. Marked down from perfect because the new test pins only the absent-key branch; the present-key branch is exercised incidentally by the pre-existing tests rather than by a test written for the gate, and no test pins that exactly one warning is emitted per stage across repeated calls to judgments_available beyond the single-call case.

justifications.fit: Extends the mechanism decisions-key-skip already built rather than adding a second one: judgments_available (candidates.py:276, itself built on the shared decisions key accessor) is imported and reused unchanged, and the early return reuses the existing latched warning so the stage warns once rather than once per source. No new predicate, no new spelling of the variable name, no new client. The node is not named in the §8 prose (which lists only decisions-key-skip and dd-path-search-rerank); it is a follow-on that closes the workers.py side of §8's second decision and belongs to that section.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Exactly reproduces the intended behaviour. On this review's reproduction of the reviewed head, with OPENROUTER_API_KEY_IMAS_CODEX absent, the stage returns promptly (elapsed well under the 10 s test deadline, not on it), claims nothing, enters neither route_ids nor judge_candidates, releases nothing, and emits exactly one warning naming the variable. Under the mutation that removes the gate, the stage claims 33,909 sources in a loop until the deadline, which is the exact failure the plan says the change removes.
